payload.text: Plan usage's primary source is the account's usage endpoint, read by intentd on a census tick after a status ask, at most every five minutes, and after a failed read no sooner than twice the previous wait, up to an hour, or a 429's Retry-After, through Claude Code's Keychain item under Claude Code's own service-name condition (the suffixed name when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is set, the bare name when it is not, no fallback between them); the Keychain read failing, the endpoint unreached, a status other than 200 and an unparseable answer are each named in `usage.error`, and a failed read after a good one keeps that reading, with when it was read, beside the failure, until a newer statusline report replaces it; outside macOS the fallback is the source.
